We retrieved template 1914393. It includes retro_smarts_template (the retrosynthetic direction). We need to propose a route using templates 1914393, 1914394, 1914395 in this order. So first apply 1914393 to target molecule, get precursors. Then apply 1914394 to one of those precursors (or maybe both) to further break down, then 1914395.

We need to generate JSON route with at least 3 reactions (so each template used). Likely a linear route: target -> reaction1 (template 1914393) -> intermediate1 -> reaction2 (1914394) -> intermediate2 -> reaction3 (1914395) -> final precursors (leaf molecules). Need to ensure each reaction's children are molecules (reactants). The route format: root is molecule (target). Its children list contains a reaction node. Reaction node has template_id and children list of precursor molecules (type mol). Then each precursor may have its own children if further reactions.

Thus we need to apply templates to get SMILES of precursors. Use apply_template tool.

First apply template 1914393 to target SMILES: COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1

Let's call apply_template.
